71	// and writes the result to cache with TTL=OneHour. `force` evicts the cache
72	// before the read so the slow path rebuilds from Mongo — mirrors the Node
73	// moderation controller's `?force` query forwarded to `findModule({ force })`
74	// (same as tempvoice/greeter/giveaway).

77		// Mongo. Mirrors the Node `findModule({ force: true })`.

80		}

85				var m dbguild.ModuleModeration

87					dbguild.NormalizeModeration(&m)

89						Data:         m,
90						Source:       "cache",
91						SourceDetail: SourceDetailModuleModerationCache,
92					}, nil
93				}
94				// Parse failure or stale schema → drop and re-read.
95				_ = r.cache.DeleteModule(ctx, botID, guildID, "moderation")
96			}
97		}
98	
99		// Slow path: project just the module_moderation block.
100		filter := bson.M{"bot_id": botID, "guild_id": guildID}
101		projection := bson.M{"module_moderation": 1}
102		var out struct {
103			ModuleModeration bson.M `bson:"module_moderation"`
104		}
105		if err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, filter, options.FindOne().SetProjection(projection)).Decode(&out); err != nil {
106			if stderrors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {

108					Data:         dbguild.ModuleModeration{},
109					Source:       "db",
110					SourceDetail: SourceDetailModuleModerationDB,
111				}, nil
112			}
113			return nil, err
114		}

116		// Se decodifica a bson.M + MigrateModerationRaw (espejo de tempvoice/música).
117		// Un decode directo al struct dejaría a CERO todos los bloques del v3 que un
118		// documento v2 no tiene (`protection`, `raid`, `antinuke`…), y sus defaults
119		// no son valores cero: ventanas, umbrales y `timeout_ms`. La migración se
120		// ejecuta SIN fiarse del `schema_version` almacenado — una escritura pudo
121		// sellar la versión actual sobre una forma sin migrar (el "veneno" que rompió
122		// tempvoice).
123		raw := out.ModuleModeration
124		var m dbguild.ModuleModeration
125		if len(raw) == 0 || dbguild.ModerationRawSchemaVersion(raw) == 0 {

145	// greeter/logs/modmail/tempvoice/giveaway use, mirroring the Node
146	// `ModuleModerationRepository.update` `mergeDeep`. A body carrying a single
147	// scalar only touches that one leaf (every other field survives); the nested
148	// blocks (`commands_global`, `mute`, `automod`) merge per-field, and the
149	// `commands` map merges per-KEY and RECURSES into each provided command value
150	// (both sides are JSON objects) — exact Node parity. Explicit
151	// `false`/`0`/`null` leaves are APPLIED: an `enabled:false` PATCH persists,
152	// and a nullable field (`log_channel_id`, `mute.role_id`) sent as explicit
153	// JSON `null` is CLEARED — Node's `mergeDeep` only skips `undefined`.

156	// `updated_at`; the repo stamps it to `now` AFTER the merge — the strict PATCH
157	// body rejects `updated_at`, and Node's `mergeDeep({...data, updated_at: new
158	// Date()})` always overwrites it. The guild-level `updatedAt` is also bumped
159	// via `$currentDate` (matching the Node `guild.save()` timestamps). The Node
160	// `checkGuildExists`→GUILD_NOT_FOUND pre-check is omitted per the greeter
161	// mold — see the handler.
162	//
163	// The full read-merge-write-cache cycle is serialised per guild.
164	func (r *ModuleModerationRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, botID, guildID string, patch map[string]any) (*Sourced[dbguild.ModuleModeration], error) {
165		unlock := r.lockKey("moderation:" + botID + "\x00" + guildID)
166		defer unlock()
167	
168		filter := bson.M{"bot_id": botID, "guild_id": guildID}
169		var before struct {
170			ModuleModeration bson.M `bson:"module_moderation"`
171		}
172		if err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, filter).Decode(&before); err != nil {
173			if stderrors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
174				return nil, nil
175			}
176			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module moderation update (pre-read): %w", err)
177		}
178	
179		// Se migra el documento existente ANTES del merge y del sellado de versión
180		// (espejo de tempvoice/música): así los bloques del v3 que falten llegan al
181		// merge con sus defaults y nunca se persiste una forma sin migrar bajo la
182		// versión actual. El merge trabaja sobre una copia, de modo que la vista del
183		// llamante nunca queda a medias.
184		raw := before.ModuleModeration
185		var merged dbguild.ModuleModeration
186		if len(raw) == 0 || dbguild.ModerationRawSchemaVersion(raw) == 0 {
187			merged = mocks.NewModuleModeration()
188		} else {
189			merged = dbguild.MigrateModerationRaw(raw)
190		}
191		// El `enabled_since` ALMACENADO se captura AQUÍ, antes del merge: `before`
192		// es un `bson.M` crudo, así que el valor tipado sólo existe una vez que la
193		// migración lo ha decodificado, y el merge posterior puede pisarlo.
194		storedEnabledSince := merged.EnabledSince
195		if err := MergeDeepJSON(&merged, patch); err != nil {
196			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module moderation update (merge): %w", err)
197		}
198		// Stamp server-side `updated_at` to `now` AFTER the merge (see doc above).
199		merged.UpdatedAt = dbguild.NewDate(time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond))
200		// Stamp schema_version directly on the merged struct so we don't conflict
201		// with the parent `module_moderation` set in the same `$set`.
202		merged.SchemaVersion = dbguild.SchemaVersionModeration
203		// Guarantee the nested collections stay non-nil ([] / {}) after the merge.
204		dbguild.NormalizeModeration(&merged)
205	
206		// `enabled_since` es WRITE-ONCE y EXCLUSIVAMENTE server-side. Se restaura
207		// primero el valor ALMACENADO, pisando lo que el merge haya podido dejar:
208		// sin esta línea un cliente que enviara `enabled_since` en el PATCH se
209		// auto-concedería derecho legacy permanente.
210		merged.EnabledSince = storedEnabledSince
211	
212		// Se estampa la PRIMERA vez que el módulo queda activado y no se reescribe
213		// nunca: desactivar no lo borra y reactivar no lo pisa — el derecho legacy
214		// se conserva para siempre (decisión de producto).
215		if merged.Enabled && merged.EnabledSince == nil {
216			stamp := dbguild.NewDate(time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond))
217			merged.EnabledSince = &stamp
218		}
219	
220		update := bson.M{
221			"$set": bson.M{
222				"module_moderation": merged,
223			},
224			"$currentDate": bson.M{"updatedAt": true},
225		}
226		opt := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
227		opt = opt.SetProjection(bson.M{"module_moderation": 1})
228		var after struct {
229			ModuleModeration dbguild.ModuleModeration `bson:"module_moderation"`
230		}
231		if err := r.coll.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opt).Decode(&after); err != nil {
232			if stderrors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
233				return nil, nil
234			}
235			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module moderation update: %w", err)
236		}
237	
238		m := after.ModuleModeration
239		dbguild.NormalizeModeration(&m)
240	
241		if fields, err := redis.MarshalModuleModeration(m); err == nil {
242			_ = r.cache.SetModule(ctx, botID, guildID, "moderation", fields, redis.ModuleTTLSeconds)
243		}
244	
245		// The write may have flipped `enabled`, so the guild's enabled_modules
246		// snapshot can no longer be trusted. See invalidateEnabledSnapshot.
247		invalidateEnabledSnapshot(ctx, r.cache, botID, guildID, "moderation")
248	
249		return &Sourced[dbguild.ModuleModeration]{
250			Data:         m,
251			Source:       "db",
252			SourceDetail: SourceDetailModuleModerationDB,
253		}, nil
254	}
255	
256	// mapToModuleModeration unmarshals a raw cache hash into the typed module.
257	// Best-effort: a parse failure returns the error so the caller can invalidate
258	// the cache and re-read from Mongo. Same bson round-trip greeter/tempvoice use —
259	// GetModule has already deserialised the JSON-encoded nested blocks
260	// (`commands_global`, `commands`, `mute`, `automod`) into map values and the
261	// `__DATE__:` `updated_at` into a native time.Time, and the `log_channel_id`
262	// empty ("") cache value back into a nil that bson round-trips to a nil
263	// `*string`.
264	func mapToModuleModeration(raw map[string]any, out *dbguild.ModuleModeration) error {
265		b, err := bson.Marshal(raw)
266		if err != nil {
267			return err
268		}
269		return bson.Unmarshal(b, out)
270	}

8		"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3"

10		"kena.bot/api-db-go/internal/domain/dbguild"
11		apierrors "kena.bot/api-db-go/internal/domain/errors"
12		"kena.bot/api-db-go/internal/domain/validations"

14		"kena.bot/api-db-go/internal/shared/result"
15	)
16	
17	// sourceDetailModerationDBNotFound is the source detail stamped on the PATCH
18	// not-found envelope (the repo returns a bare nil there, so the handler has no
19	// Sourced to read it from). Kept in step with
20	// `mongo.SourceDetailModuleModerationDB` — the handler can't import the mongo
21	// infra package without a layering violation, so the string is duplicated
22	// locally, à la `sourceDetailGiveawayDBNotFound` in module_giveaway_handler.go.
23	const sourceDetailModerationDBNotFound = "mongo.guild.module_moderation"
24	
25	// ModuleModerationHandler wires the two moderation endpoints behind a single
26	// struct.
27	//
28	// Mirrors `module-moderation-controller.ts` (the guild-scoped GET/PATCH).
29	//
30	// The result payload is `*dbguild.ModuleModeration` (pointer) so the not-found
31	// paths can emit `"data":null` — matching the Node controller, whose GET / PATCH
32	// not-found branches run `applySourceAndStash(sourced{data:null})` before
33	// throwing MODULE_NOT_FOUND (same as modmail/tempvoice/giveaway, tighter than the
34	// greeter/logs/music value-payload handlers).
35	//
36	// DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from the Node controller (consistent with the
37	// greeter/modmail/tempvoice/giveaway mold, which also skips the guild pre-check):
38	//   - No `GuildRepository.checkGuildExists` → GUILD_NOT_FOUND pre-check on PATCH.
39	//     A missing guild makes the repo return nil, which the handler maps to
40	//     MODULE_NOT_FOUND (data:null) — the same not-found signal the update-null
41	//     branch produces, not GUILD_NOT_FOUND.
42	type ModuleModerationHandler struct {
43		Repo mongorepo.ModuleModerationRepo
44	}
45	
46	// NewModuleModerationHandler builds the handler.
47	func NewModuleModerationHandler(repo mongorepo.ModuleModerationRepo) *ModuleModerationHandler {
48		return &ModuleModerationHandler{Repo: repo}
49	}
50	
51	// Get mirrors `getModuleModerationController`. Returns the full moderation subdoc
52	// (default-filled + normalised) with source headers stamped, or a 400
53	// MODULE_NOT_FOUND with `data:null` + source when the guild has no moderation
54	// block yet. Honors the optional `?force=true` query that evicts the cache before
55	// reading (the Node controller parses it via `querySkipCacheValidation` and
56	// forwards it to `findModule({ force })`).
57	func (h *ModuleModerationHandler) Get(c fiber.Ctx) error {
58		r := result.New[*dbguild.ModuleModeration]()
59		ctx := c.Context()
60	
61		force, _ := strconv.ParseBool(c.Query("force"))
62	
63		sourced, err := h.Repo.FindModule(ctx, c.Params("bot_id"), c.Params("guild_id"), force)
64		if err != nil {
65			r.AddError(apierrors.New(apierrors.Props{
66				Message:    err.Error(),
67				Type:       apierrors.TypeInternal,
68				Context:    apierrors.ContextSystem,
69				StatusCode: 500,
70			}))
71			return reply(c, r)
72		}
73		// Stamp the source from the repo even on the not-found path — the FindModule
74		// no-document branch still carries "db" / the module detail, mirroring the
75		// Node applySourceAndStash(sourced{data:null}).
76		if sourced != nil {
77			r.SetSource(result.Source(sourced.Source), sourced.SourceDetail)
78		}
79		if sourced == nil || sourced.Data.SchemaVersion == 0 {
80			r.SetData(nil)
81			r.AddError(apierrors.MongoMessage("Module not found", apierrors.CodeModuleNotFound))
82			return reply(c, r)
83		}
84		d := sourced.Data
85		r.SetData(&d)
86		return reply(c, r)
87	}
88	
89	// Patch mirrors `patchModuleModerationController`. Strict body
90	// (DisallowUnknownFields, matching the zod `.strict()`) validates the shape;
91	// the SAME body is then re-decoded as a raw `map[string]any` so key PRESENCE
92	// survives, and the repo MergeDeepJSON-merges it into the current subdoc — a
93	// partial PATCH preserves untouched fields, nested-block siblings, and per-key
94	// `commands` overrides, and explicit `false`/`0`/`null` leaves are APPLIED
95	// (mirrors the Node `mergeDeep`, which only skips `undefined`). An empty body
96	// `{}` is a no-op that still bumps schema_version + updated_at (Node returns
97	// 200). A missing guild → 400 MODULE_NOT_FOUND with `data:null`.
98	func (h *ModuleModerationHandler) Patch(c fiber.Ctx) error {
99		r := result.New[*dbguild.ModuleModeration]()
100		ctx := c.Context()
101	
102		var body validations.UpdateModuleModerationBody
103		dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(c.Body()))
104		dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
105		if err := dec.Decode(&body); err != nil {
106			r.AddError(apierrors.New(apierrors.Props{
107				Message:    err.Error(),
108				Type:       apierrors.TypeValidation,
109				Context:    apierrors.ContextAPI,
110				StatusCode: 400,
111			}))
112			return reply(c, r)
113		}
114	
115		// Re-decode the (already validated) body as a raw map so key presence
116		// survives — explicit false/0/null must reach the merge (Node parity).
117		patch, err := patchMap(c.Body())
118		if err != nil {
119			r.AddError(apierrors.New(apierrors.Props{
120				Message:    err.Error(),
121				Type:       apierrors.TypeValidation,
122				Context:    apierrors.ContextAPI,
123				StatusCode: 400,
124			}))
125			return reply(c, r)
126		}
127	
128		// The strict decode above only checks JSON shape — an enum field accepts
129		// ANY string, including "". This normalizes empty-enum leaves (an unset
130		// dashboard <select>, never "configured to nothing") and rejects the
131		// configs the bot genuinely cannot carry out, which until now only the
132		// browser's zod caught. See NormalizeModerationPatch.
133		if verr := validations.NormalizeModerationPatch(patch); verr != nil {
134			r.AddError(verr)
135			return reply(c, r)
136		}
137	
138		sourced, err := h.Repo.Update(ctx, c.Params("bot_id"), c.Params("guild_id"), patch)
139		if err != nil {
140			r.AddError(apierrors.New(apierrors.Props{
141				Message:    err.Error(),
142				Type:       apierrors.TypeInternal,
143				Context:    apierrors.ContextSystem,
144				StatusCode: 500,
145			}))
146			return reply(c, r)
147		}
148		if sourced == nil || sourced.Data.SchemaVersion == 0 {
149			// Node's update-null branch stamps db + a source detail + data:null
150			// before throwing MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The repo returns a bare nil here,
151			// so stamp the source by hand.
152			r.SetSource(result.SourceDB, sourceDetailModerationDBNotFound)
153			r.SetData(nil)
154			r.AddError(apierrors.MongoMessage("Module not found", apierrors.CodeModuleNotFound))
155			return reply(c, r)
156		}
157		d := sourced.Data
158		r.SetData(&d)
159		r.SetSource(result.Source(sourced.Source), sourced.SourceDetail)
160		return reply(c, r)
161	}
